title: Podkletnov rumored to work for an American contractor

tellings.quote: once upon a time I was told he was working for an American contractor

plain: A scientist named Eugene Podkletnov is said to have gone to work for an American defence contractor. Salvatore Pais, a Navy scientist who holds patents on unusual craft designs, tells Michels only that "once upon a time I was told he was working for an American contractor", without saying who told him.
